action.description: Confirm the label on every product you sell still carries the statements Chapter 437 requires, including your home address and the 'not inspected' statement.

items.summary: No change to the law itself this month — but the statute is the floor everything else stands on, so we re-read it every cycle. Chapter 437 of the Health & Safety Code is what allows you to sell specific homemade foods from home. It sets the allowed-food list, the annual gross-income cap, and the exact statements your labels must carry.
items.title: Governing statute re-verified: Texas Cottage Food Law (Health & Safety Code ch. 437)
